title: Dark pattern scam
body:
Total scam — hidden bundle subscriptions and a deliberately deceptive cancellation flow

What starts as a free trial quickly turns into 500 DKK charged to your credit card every other month — without any clear disclosure upfront.

When I tried to cancel, I found out why: the cancellation screen only shows the free trial subscription as ended, while their so-called "bundle" subscriptions are buried further down in the same popup, hidden behind two separate buttons you'd never think to scroll to or tap.

Two charges of 253,99 DKK hit my card every two months — routed directly to my credit card, bypassing Apple's subscription center entirely, so you won't even see it in your iPhone subscription overview.

This is a textbook dark pattern. I've filed complaints with my bank, contacted the company directly demanding a full refund, and reported the practice to the French consumer authority (DGCCRF). I'd encourage anyone in a similar situation to do the same.

Stay far away.

title: Giving anxiety from the get go, instead of helping it
body:
I subscribed to a one week trial which I paid for. I wanted to cancel my subscription, because I only wanted to try the app for a week and not get charged for a full month once the week was over.

However I could not find my plan on the website and there was no cancel button. My plan says I have a free subscription, which is not true as I paid for the one week trial.

I also checked my apple subscriptions and I could not cancel there either.

After a while of looking on the website, I was able to submit a ticket to cancel my subscription, but the robot that answered  says that the “current cycle” is canceled. It does not specify the date from which my subscription is canceled from. So now I am gonna be sitting here for a week being anxious about my subscription being canceled. I truly hope that it did get canceled. Hard to confirm this with a robot as it gave a sandard repeating answer to all my questions.

The UI and the website are confusing. Subscription status should be more clear and cancel button should be there at all times.

I think this app is praying on people with ADHD and makes their subscription hard to cancel so we forget it and they can charge us more money. 

Absolutely do not recommend and I am not even interested anymore in trying the app.

title: Best money I spent in App Store
body:
This app has a few technical glitches but I appreciate it tremendously nonetheless. I’ve been using it for almost a year now, and I’m not done changing my life.

I was very much in doubt about whether I should pay for this app, whether it’d be worth the money, whether I’d actually use it… Turned out to be the best money I’d spent in App Store so far.

My favorite feature is the nightly coaching which helps me get closure from the day and gives me confidence to continue my journey of change.

Change truly comes from small changes repeated regularly over time.

Ideas for improvement:
 - affirmations in the app
 - connecting to YouTube Music
 - helping people go back, when we’ve bit off more than we can choose. There’s no “nice” way to delete habits without losing the historical data

However, the app simply lacks polish. Especially considering it's price. There is too much confusing UI and it has many small bugs. For instance sometimes text automatically advances way to fast for me to read, you can't go back in the audio, I once landed in on a page which I couldn't navigate away from and I had to force close the app, the app is constantly pestering me to share stuff on social media, etc.

This app has potential and I will keep an eye on it but for the price it needs more work.
